profile_text.body:
Ericsson LM Telephone Co is a public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, and trades under the ticker ERIC. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000717826. On its website, the company describes itself as powering the networks that connect billions, working across 5G, AI, and cloud technologies for communications providers and enterprises.

The site presents Ericsson's work in several areas: 5G and AI-driven automation, enterprise connectivity that combines 5G, AI, and cloud, network slicing and orchestration tools, and trusted AI for networks. It also covers the company's perspective on 6G, described as an intelligent fabric connecting people and machines through mobile, cloud, and AI systems, and cites AT&T's Open Radio Access Network transformation as laying the foundation for an open, disaggregated, and programmable network.

The record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for the company.
